next.reason: 1985: "the data-name specified as the subject of the entry whose level-number is 01 ... must not be the same data-name"; 2023: "the externalized name of the subject of the entry ... shall not be the same as the externalized name of any other entry". 2023 compares externalized names, which AS literal-1 can override, and also covers file entries. Equal data-names with different literals pass; different names with equal literals fail.
